result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make the consequences of our actions on other people impossible to abstract away. Not force anyone to be good—just remove the anesthesia. In the moment you’re about to hurt someone, you’d feel exactly what it does to them, as them, while still knowing it’s you doing it.

Keep all the freedom, conflict, love, and mess. But delete the distance that lets cruelty feel clean.
